what.zh: 想清楚怎么拆、怎么组合；直接操控 Blender 搭场景、调灯光和氛围、摆镜头；最后拍板通过还是回炉。
what.en: Plans how to split and recombine; drives Blender to build the scene, light it and frame it; makes the final pass/rework call.

what.zh: 生图做材质：无缝贴图、局部重绘、干净的颜色图；写 Blender 建模脚本，补 Tripo 做不好的部件。
what.en: Images for materials: seamless textures, repaints, clean colour maps; writes Blender modelling scripts for parts Tripo gets wrong.

what.zh: 快速批量出单件底模；需要时用分件、重贴图、重拓扑、绑骨等后处理接口。
what.en: Fast, parallel base models per piece; post-processing such as segmentation, re-texturing, retopology and rigging when needed.

what.zh: 跑只读结构质检（inspect_asset.py），搜参考；也可以当跨家评审。
what.en: Runs read-only structural QA (inspect_asset.py) and finds references; can act as the cross-vendor critic.

what.zh: 所有修改真正发生的地方：无界面脚本执行、渲染、导出验证。
what.en: Where every change actually happens: headless scripts, renders, export checks.

text.zh: 复杂场景拆成 4 个单件 + 程序化桌面，先画平面图定尺寸。
text.en: Split the scene into 4 pieces + a procedural table; plan sizes on a floor plan first.

text.zh: 每个单件一张参考图，并行图生 3D。
text.en: One reference per piece, image-to-3D in parallel.

text.zh: 在 Blender 里按平面图组合、打光、出四视角图。
text.en: Assemble from the plan in Blender, light it, render four views.

text.zh: 另一家看图打分、列问题（本次实际由独立的 Claude 子代理完成：6 → 6.5 分）。
text.en: Another vendor scores and lists flaws (this run used an independent Claude sub-agent: 6 → 6.5).

text.zh: 每个问题交给最合适的那一家，通过 team-sync 任务板派活，互不踩文件。
text.en: Each flaw goes to the best-suited AI via the team-sync task board, without file clashes.

text.zh: 材质、补件、氛围并行修，修完再评审，直到 9 分。
text.en: Materials, missing parts and mood fixed in parallel, then reviewed again until 9/10.

title.zh: 评审台的玻璃罩变成了不透明半壳
title.en: The critic rig's glass dome came out as an opaque shell

how.zh: Astra 写 Blender 脚本，建一个透明玻璃圆柱和发光环，替换掉这个部件；Opus 负责摆位和打光。
how.en: Astra scripts a transparent glass cylinder and glowing ring in Blender to replace that part; Opus places and lights it.

tripo.zh: 或者用 Tripo 分件（/mesh/segment，40 credits）把罩子拆出来，再单独换材质。
tripo.en: Or split it out with Tripo segmentation (/mesh/segment, 40 credits) and re-material it.

title.zh: 打印机贴图有涂抹，货架上的城堡顶有黑斑
title.en: Smeared printer texture, black smudges on the shelf castles

how.zh: Astra 生图出干净的颜色图，或对贴图做局部重绘，再由 Opus 接回材质节点。
how.en: Astra generates a clean colour map or repaints the texture; Opus wires it back into the material.

tripo.zh: 或者用 Tripo 重新贴图（/models/texture，HD 20 credits），传入原参考图。
tripo.en: Or re-texture with Tripo (/models/texture, HD 20 credits) using the original reference.

title.zh: 桌面木纹太淡，导出到网页后变成白色
title.en: Table grain too faint, and it turns white once exported to the web

how.zh: Astra 生一张无缝胡桃木贴图，替换 Blender 的程序化节点。贴图能正常导出到 glTF，网页里也会显示正确。
how.en: Astra generates a seamless walnut texture to replace the procedural nodes; image textures export to glTF, so the web view is right too.

tripo.zh: 生图本身可以走 Tripo text-to-image（seedream 5 credits）。
tripo.en: The image itself can come from Tripo text-to-image (seedream, 5 credits).

title.zh: 传送带走向不对，发光和氛围不够
title.en: Belt routing is wrong; glow and mood are weak

how.zh: Opus 直接操控 Blender：让传送带依次串起四个工位，提高发光强度，加暖色主光、紫色霓虹和景深，调整低机位镜头。
how.en: Opus drives Blender directly: route the belt through all four stations, raise emission, add a warm key, purple neon and depth of field, fix the low-angle camera.

title.zh: 模型上有尖刺，三角面很乱

how.zh: Opus 在 Blender 里删除游离点和退化面；面数或拓扑要求更高时，交给 Tripo 重拓扑。
how.en: Opus deletes loose verts and degenerate faces in Blender; for stricter budgets hand it to Tripo retopology.

tripo.zh: Tripo 重拓扑 v3.0（/mesh/decimate，三角 35 credits），可以加 smart_uv。
tripo.en: Tripo retopology v3.0 (/mesh/decimate, tris 35 credits), optionally with smart_uv.

title.zh: 评审不应该由同一家来做
title.en: Review shouldn’t come from the same vendor

how.zh: 下一轮改走 team-sync 任务板，交给 Grok 或 Codex 评审，减少自己给自己打分的偏差。
how.en: Next round goes through the team-sync board to Grok or Codex, avoiding self-grading bias.
